diagnostics.message: `google_project_iam_member.additive` grants whatever roles are listed in `var.iam_additive_roles`, which can include the custom roles created by `google_project_iam_custom_role.roles` in this same module. A role cannot be granted before it exists, so the additive member must be ordered after the custom role. The sibling authoritative binding already expresses exactly this ordering with `depends_on = [google_project_iam_custom_role.roles]`, but the additive member relies only on input variables, so no implicit dependency exists and the two can race.
